meta.parties: Hay v. The Official Administrator of the Estate of the Late R. W. Nunn, Deceased

rules.statement: Section 199 of the Civil Procedure Code allows for a rateable distribution among all creditors in an administration suit, not just testamentary actions.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hold therefore that the order of the District Court of Kandy of the 27th November, 1905, is a nullity, and that Cargills, Ltd., and the other creditors who have appeared are entitled to the fund in Court rateably."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 199 of the Civil Procedure Code
